parts.name: neck_shoulder_pitch_fixed_capture_pin
parts.notes: D1.5 spring pin through the steel central shoulder positively retains the printed socket axially. Printed 1.6 mm slot is widened tangentially to let the hex faces take torque. Both ends remain inside the original housing envelope. Insert before the bearings.

parts.name: neck_shoulder_pitch_face_pad_-1
parts.notes: Stock-sized face pad; loaded annulus lies outside the recessed bearing outer diameter.

parts.name: neck_shoulder_pitch_face_pad_1
parts.notes: Stock-sized face pad; loaded annulus lies outside the recessed bearing outer diameter.

parts.name: neck_shoulder_pitch_rear_thrust_cap
parts.notes: Rear cap positively keyed to the integral shaft hex; both brake faces transmit holding torque without relying on washer/head friction.

parts.name: neck_shoulder_pitch_keyed_output_cap
parts.notes: Cross-pinned steel cap; external hex transfers torque to printed output socket.

parts.name: neck_shoulder_pitch_output_socket
parts.notes: Continuous 2.05 mm minimum corner ligament, 3 mm axial hex engagement; locknut remains tool-accessible through the bore.

parts.name: neck_shoulder_pitch_shaft
parts.notes: 42CrMo4 +QT shaft, certified yield >=750 MPa after machining. Precision journal, threaded tip and cross hole. D6/M4 shoulders stop 0.5 mm behind the thrust washer so they cannot bypass preload.

parts.name: neck_shoulder_pitch_locknut
parts.notes: All preload threads in metal. Hip pitch and lumbar yaw use DIN439 thin nuts, removable metal thread-lock and positive end pins; other cartridges use nylon locknuts.
